story.title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs

draft:
Demis Hassabis is stepping down as CEO of Google DeepMind to become its chair. 
I'm intrigued by this move, as it suggests a shift in focus for the company. 
Hassabis will remain involved in the company's research and direction. 
What does this change mean for the future of AI development at DeepMind?
#GoogleDeepMind #AIresearch #TechLeadership
